name: Jessica Steinmann

accounts.evidence: Her campaign site (Jessica Hart Steinmann, Trump-endorsed candidate for TX-08) links to x.com/TeamSteinmann.

notes: No personal account was linked from the campaign site. Ballotpedia blocked automated access, so it could not be checked.

name: Leticia Gutierrez
notes: Her campaign site leticiaforcongress.com links Facebook and Instagram, but its X icon points to the template placeholder x.com/candidate, not a real handle. Branch, BallotReady, iVoterGuide and an Off the Kuff interview page showed no X handle. Ballotpedia blocked automated access. Two searches used, none refused.

name: Chris Gober

accounts.evidence: His campaign site (Republican for Texas's 10th Congressional District) links to x.com/ChrisKGober.

notes: The site is a campaign site, but the handle is name-based, so it may be his personal account used for the campaign. Only one X account was linked.

name: Mark Teixeira
